primary.$description: The app's interactive accent: filled buttons, text-button labels, selected nav, links, focus ring, progress.

on-primary.$description: Label on a primary fill: the brand's reversed-out white.

primary-container.$description: Contained companion of the brand: the nav indicator, the fill a label sits on when raw indigo would miss AA.

secondary.$description: Secondary indigo, one step lighter than the brand.

tertiary.$description: The success tone as a scheme role.

error.$description: The unreachable tone as a scheme role.

on-error.$description: Label on an error fill: white measures 3.76:1 there, this ink 4.71:1.

surface.$description: Room Floor: the scaffold behind every screen.

on-surface.$description: Bright Label: primary text and icons on every surface and container.

surface-container-lowest.$description: Sub-floor: recessed wells such as log panels and code blocks.

surface-container-low.$description: Riser: the first raised step above the floor; grouped-list backgrounds.

surface-container.$description: Panel: cards, bottom sheets, dialogs, KPI tiles, and the navigation bar.

surface-container-high.$description: Raised Panel: secondary panels and the ground accent chips most often sit on.

surface-container-highest.$description: Instrument Face: input and chip fill, carrying on-surface-variant labels.

on-surface-variant.$description: Secondary Label: metadata, chip labels, input hints, unselected nav.

dim-text.$description: Dim Label: editorial captions and tertiary metadata on surface and surface-container. Below AA on surface-container-high; use the plate dim ink on plates.

outline.$description: Hairline: dividers, outlined buttons and cards, the rare boundary a tint cannot draw.

outline-variant.$description: Grouped surfaces, genre chips, KPI tile border. The same byte as outline.

shadow.$description: The ink every elevation level paints its shadow in.

on-inverse-surface.$description: Snackbar text on the inverse surface.

inverse-primary.$description: The brand on an inverse surface.

glass-surface.$description: Opacity of surface-container in the floating nav bar's glass fill. A tint, not a backdrop blur.

ambient-glow.$description: Centre of the ambient accent wash behind headers and the onboarding canvas.

contact.$description: Opacity of the level-1 contact shadow.

ambient.$description: Opacity of the level-1 ambient shadow.

contact.$description: Opacity of the level-2 contact shadow.

ambient.$description: Opacity of the level-2 ambient shadow.

contact.$description: Opacity of the level-3 contact shadow.

ambient.$description: Opacity of the level-3 ambient shadow.
Opacity of the glass bar's ambient shadow.

highlight.$description: Opacity of the glass bar's 1px top highlight.
